# Security

Vanish holds signed-in sessions for people's accounts, so security reports
matter a lot here.

Report a problem privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/itsmeares/vanish/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue for it.

Useful things to include: what an attacker could do, the steps to reproduce
it, and the Vanish version and system. Never include real cookies, tokens or
passwords; a throwaway account is enough to show the problem.
